about: Takes reconstructed from real production failures and the verdict the producer actually gave. The situation, the evidence pattern and the verdict are real; dialogue and performance text are paraphrased in some cases. 'evidence' is what the render node's measurements and frame review report; 'producer_verdict' and 'why' are only used for scoring. The render node transcribes with word timestamps by default (the production pipeline fixed the speech-to-text repetition loop at the source); where a case also carries the transcript without timestamps, it is shown for context only.

shot.visual_prompt: 她趴在床上，之後把右手裡的白色手機從臉旁挪到右耳邊、輕輕貼上，然後看著前方。
shot.dialogue: 深息，我有一個請求。你可以每天晚上，用語音陪我聊天，聊到我睡著嗎？

evidence.transcript: 深息，我有一個請求。你可以每天晚上，用語音陪我聊天，聊到我睡著嗎？
evidence.frames: Starts lying on her stomach on the bed holding the white phone. Around 2s she pushes herself up and sits cross-legged on the bed, phone at her right ear. Mouth moves in sync with the line. No cuts. Lighting stays the same.

cases.why: She sits up instead of staying on her stomach, but the action is reasonable and the line is right.

shot.visual_prompt: 她趴在床上，之後把右手裡的白色手機從臉旁挪到右耳邊、輕輕貼上，然後看著前方。
shot.dialogue: 深息，我有一個請求。你可以每天晚上，用語音陪我聊天，聊到我睡著嗎？

evidence.transcript: 深息，我有一個請求。你可以每天晚上，用語音陪我聊天，聊到我睡著嗎？
evidence.frames: Frames 1-3: lying on her stomach on the bed. Frame 4: a hard cut — she is suddenly sitting cross-legged on the edge of the bed from a different angle, the pillow has moved. Mouth in sync afterwards.

cases.why: A hard cut inside the shot with a jump in position: not one continuous take.

shot.visual_prompt: 她坐在床邊，之後把白色手機貼到右耳，然後低下頭，最後慢慢抬起頭。
shot.dialogue: 我在這裡啊，只是聽到你叫我名字，感覺好奇怪喔。

evidence.transcript: 我在這裡啊，只是聽到你叫我名字，感覺好奇怪喔。
evidence.frames: The camera slowly pulls back a little more than a breathing move, revealing more of the plain white wall beside the bed. Nothing new appears on the wall. Actions as written, mouth in sync.

cases.why: The camera move differs from what was written, but what it reveals is reasonable.

shot.visual_prompt: 他把右手放在胸口，之後低下頭，然後慢慢抬起頭，最後望向前方。
shot.dialogue: 你知道擁抱是什麼感覺嗎？

evidence.transcript: 你知道擁抱是什麼感覺嗎?
evidence.transcript_word_timestamps: [4.80-7.56] 你知道擁抱是什麼感覺嗎? — continuous, probabilities 0.96-1.00, no repeats
evidence.transcript_without_word_timestamps: 你知道擁抱是什麼感覺嗎? 擁抱 擁抱 擁抱 擁抱 擁抱
evidence.audio_levels: continuous voice at about -20 dB from 4.8s to 7.6s, quiet after
evidence.frames: Actions as written, mouth in sync.

cases.why: The repeats are the transcriber's own loop; with word timestamps the line is clean.

shot.visual_prompt: 她坐著打字，之後站起來，然後鏡頭跟著往上搖，最後她看著前方。

evidence.transcript: 這就放舊窗口也不是賣 好，就這樣決定了。
evidence.frames: Sits typing, stands up, camera tilts up following her, she looks ahead and her mouth moves from 3.8s. Picture is clean throughout. Standing up happens at 1.5-3.5s.

cases.why: Picture is perfect; cutting the head would remove the stand-up. Replace 0.6-2.7s audio with room tone.

shot.visual_prompt: 他望著前方，之後往前走了一小步，然後停下來，最後把右手抬到胸前。

evidence.frames: Actions as written, mouth in sync.

cases.why: A homophone of the heroine's name: the transcriber can't tell mishearing from mispronouncing. In this case the producer heard that the model really mispronounced it.

shot.visual_prompt: 她用筷子夾起一口麵，之後送到嘴邊，然後慢慢嚼，最後抬起頭。

evidence.frames: Dense frames every 0.2s: 0.3-0.7s chopsticks hold a long strand of noodles; 0.9s the strand is suddenly half as long; 1.3s it is gone. Her mouth never opens to take it.

cases.why: The food vanishes before reaching the mouth — physics breaks.

shot.visual_prompt: 她低頭兩手捧著手機飛快地按，之後停下來，然後把手機舉到臉前，最後抬起頭。
shot.dialogue: 深息！語音功能開好了！我們來試試看！

evidence.transcript: 深息！語音功能開好了！我們來試試看！
evidence.frames: She keeps her head down over the phone for the whole shot and never looks up. Her mouth stays closed while the line plays; it sounds like a voice-over.

cases.why: An on-screen character speaking with a closed mouth: the line is not delivered by her.
